1	// Part: room: greenhouse (interior furnisher + lamplighter). Inner air x5..20, z65..74, y1..8 (plan.md FLOORS, rooms.json).
2	// Focal piece: the potting wall along the west end, in line with the east door: a fence-and-top-slab bench with pots and
3	// standing lanterns. Planting benches run along both long walls; water barrels and a water tub sit in the east corners;
4	// a potting stool stands in the middle; hanging lanterns come off chains under the ridge. The gravel floor (y0) and the
5	// glass shell belong to the grounds part; the lane z69..70 from the east door stays clear.
6	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
7	
8	const ORIGIN_X = 5;
9	const ORIGIN_Z = 65;
10	const WIDTH = 16; // x5..20
11	
12	const LEGEND = {
13	  f: "dark_oak_fence", // bench legs and the potting-wall posts (connections set after)
14	  t: ["dark_oak_slab", { type: "top" }], // bench tops: the fence is 1.5 high, so the top slab sits on it at y2
15	  p: "flower_pot",
16	  l: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }], // stands on a top slab
17	  h: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }], // hangs from the chain above it
18	  c: ["iron_chain", { axis: "y" }],
19	  b: "barrel",
20	  w: ["water_cauldron", { level: "3" }],
21	  s: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }], // potting stool
22	};
23	
24	// Rows run along +x (x5..x20), successive rows along +z (z65..z74). Short rows are padded with air ('.').
25	const pad = (rows) => rows.map((r) => r.padEnd(WIDTH, "."));
26	
27	// y1: floor level. Fences under the benches, barrels and cauldron in the east corners, the stool, the west posts.
28	const Y1 = pad([
29	  "..ffffff.fffffbw",
30	  "f..........l",
31	  "f",
32	  "f",
33	  "f",
34	  "f...s",
35	  "f",
36	  "f",
37	  "f........l.l",
38	  "..ffffff.fffffbw",
39	]);
40	
41	// y2: bench tops (top slabs on the fences), the west table top, a pot on each east barrel.
42	const Y2 = pad([
43	  "..tttttt.tttttp",
44	  "t",
45	  "t",
46	  "t",
47	  "t",
48	  "t",
49	  "t",
50	  "t",
51	  "t",
52	  "..tttttt.tttttp",
53	]);
54	
55	// y3: things standing on the tops: pots and standing lanterns on the potting wall and the benches.
56	const Y3 = pad([
57	  "..p.l.p..p.p",
58	  "p",
59	  "l",
60	  "p",
61	  "p",
62	  "l",
63	  "p",
64	  "p",
65	  "l",
66	  "...p...p..l..p",
67	]);
68	
69	// y7 and y8: the hanging lantern (y7) under its chain (y8), over the lane at z69 (x9 and x16).
70	const Y7 = pad(["", "", "", "", "....h......h"]);
71	const Y8 = pad(["", "", "", "", "....c......c"]);
72	
73	export function build(g) {
74	  layers(g, [ORIGIN_X, 1, ORIGIN_Z], LEGEND, Y1);
75	  layers(g, [ORIGIN_X, 2, ORIGIN_Z], LEGEND, Y2);
76	  layers(g, [ORIGIN_X, 3, ORIGIN_Z], LEGEND, Y3);
77	  layers(g, [ORIGIN_X, 7, ORIGIN_Z], LEGEND, Y7);
78	  layers(g, [ORIGIN_X, 8, ORIGIN_Z], LEGEND, Y8);
79	
80	  // Fence posts join their neighbours: read the connections from the y1 layer (layers() writes plain posts).
81	  const isFence = (j, i) => Y1[j]?.[i] === "f";
82	  for (let j = 0; j < Y1.length; j++) {
83	    for (let i = 0; i < WIDTH; i++) {
84	      if (!isFence(j, i)) continue;
85	      const state = {
86	        north: String(isFence(j - 1, i)),
87	        south: String(isFence(j + 1, i)),
88	        east: String(isFence(j, i + 1)),
89	        west: String(isFence(j, i - 1)),
90	      };
91	      g.set(ORIGIN_X + i, 1, ORIGIN_Z + j, "dark_oak_fence", state);
92	    }
93	  }
94	}
95

input.summary:
room: greenhouse (parts/room-37.mjs) now places 85 blocks with 0 refused and 0 off-palette; make.sh writes build.nbt.
Fix: the five refused cells were the greenhouse helper's smooth_quartz_slab benches on z66 and z73 (x5..20, y1). Removed the y1 fence and lanterns there; the lanterns now stand on the bench at y2 (x16 z66; x14 and x16 z73).
Also dropped the x5 bench top and pot at z66 and z73 (y2/y3), which would float without the fence.
left: Whole-build make.sh still reports REFUSED writes from other parts (entrance hall, parlour, dining, butler's pantry, powder room, kitchen, bedrooms 3/5/6, ground gallery, cottage bath, gazebo). These are outside this job's scope and were not touched.

Design change: the x5 bench top and pot at z66 and z73 are gone, and the two lanterns moved from y1 to y2. Worth a look in the render, since the lantern placement on the bench slab was not visually checked.

waste.what: Hand-traced which of the greenhouse's y1 cells belong to the greenhouse helper's bench slabs (z0+2 and z1-2 rows, x0+1..x1-1), then worked out by hand that the y2 top and y3 pot above the removed fence would float.
waste.cost: about 6 cell-by-cell checks across y1..y3 plus 2 make.sh runs (one to reproduce, one to verify)
waste.tool: A `layers()` dry-run or `mcd plan build.nbt --rooms rooms.json` that lists, per layer, the cells an earlier part already holds, with the owning part's name, before the part writes. A support check in layers() (flag any block whose cell below is air or a top slab) would also have caught the floating top slab and pot.

waste.what: Read parts-report.json by hand to confirm offPalette was empty. The make.sh summary only prints the REFUSED line.
waste.tool: make.sh (or runParts) could print each part's offPalette count next to its refused count, so the OFF-PALETTE check does not need a separate report read.

companions.task: Decide whether the x5 bench end should keep a fence leg and top slab, by redesigning the bench where it meets the greenhouse helper's slab row, rather than dropping it.
Check the moved standing lanterns on the y2 bench (x16 z66; x14 and x16 z73) against the room's light levels with mcd light, since they moved up one row.
